research_question: In adults, what is the effect of remote or web 2.0 physical activity interventions compared with placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention on self-reported physical activity measured at 12 months follow-up?
treatment_label: remote or web 2.0 physical activity intervention
control_label: placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention
outcome_description: Continuous self-reported physical activity at 12 months follow-up (e.g., minutes per week, MET-minutes per week, self-report scale scores; excluding cardiorespiratory fitness, dichotomous outcomes, and 24-month follow-up)
positive_direction: Higher self-reported physical activity in the remote/web 2.0 intervention group compared with the control group at 12 months follow-up
search_queries: remote web physical activity intervention randomized controlled trial
internet web 2.0 physical activity trial 12 month follow up
online digital physical activity intervention controlled trial outcome
inclusion_criteria: Randomized controlled trials evaluating remote, web-based, or Web 2.0 physical activity interventions in adults
Comparison to a control group receiving placebo, no intervention, waitlist, or minimal intervention
Quantitative continuous reporting of self-reported physical activity at or near 12 months follow-up with data extractable for standardized mean differences (means, SDs, sample sizes)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical randomized controlled trial (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, study protocols, editorials, and non-RCTs are excluded)
No comparison between a remote/web 2.0 intervention and a placebo, no intervention, or minimal intervention control condition

No extractable quantitative continuous data for self-reported physical activity at or near 12 months follow-up (e.g., exclusively cardiorespiratory fitness, dichotomous outcomes like meeting guidelines, or exclusively 24-month data)
Completely unrelated to remote or web 2.0 physical activity interventions in adult populations
moderators_to_extract: Delivery platform / intervention type (e.g., website, Web 2.0 social features, mobile web)
Control group type (no intervention/waitlist vs. minimal intervention vs. attention placebo)
Physical activity measurement tool (e.g., IPAQ, 7-day recall, self-report questionnaire)
Participant population characteristics (general adult vs. clinical/at-risk population; mean age)
Intervention duration and active support components (e.g., automated vs. human feedback)
effect_size_note: Extract raw arm-level mean, SD, and N for self-reported physical activity at the 12-month timepoint (or closest assessment if multiple are reported). Pool across studies using standardized mean difference (SMD).
